tracce.caption: modern electronic, electro house, tech promo. Energetic, bright, clean and confident. Instruments: punchy four-on-the-floor kick, crisp claps, sidechained supersaw chords, plucky arpeggiated lead with a subtle chiptune square-wave touch, tight sub bass, short risers. Vocals: instrumental, no vocals. Production: clean modern mix, wide stereo, polished, strong drop at the start, no long intro.

modern electronic, future bass, upbeat tech product video. Energetic but clean, optimistic. Instruments: tight kick and snare, sidechained wide synth chords, bouncy 8-bit arpeggio lead, warm sub bass, white-noise sweeps. Vocals: instrumental, no vocals. Production: clean professional mix, punchy, bright top end, quick build into drop.
